evidence.text: The FY guide sits above what the street models, so the sales range is likely to be trimmed. Comparable sales grew 3.7% in Q1 2026 and 4.8% in Q2, about 4.3% for H1. Q3 revenue consensus of $12.97-13.0B, on a combined base of $12.24B (Abbott Q3 2025 $11.39B plus Exact Sciences Q3 2025 $851M), implies only about 6% reported. That is roughly 6-7% comparable depending on FX, against a Q3 2025 comp of 7.5% organic. If consensus is right, Abbott has to narrow or cut the FY comparable range on this print. If it prints 8%+ comparable, the guide holds and the H2-acceleration thesis is validated.

If a cut were fully priced, put skew would be bid and estimates would sit at the guide's low end with commentary to match.
evidence.independence: Three independent primary or secondary documents: the Abbott Q1 and Q2 releases, the Exact Sciences Q3 2025 8-K and the Hudson Labs and Earnings Whispers consensus. If a nonaccrual-plus-reserve outcome were fully priced, the skew would be put-bid; it is flat (+0.48), and the stock has rallied off its one-month low since Oct 13.
